findings.title: Browser report age/timestamp mutual-exclusion check uses truthiness
findings.body: validate_timestamp does `if self.initial_data.get("age")` and validate_age does `if self.initial_data.get("timestamp")`. A value of 0 is falsy, so a report with `timestamp: 0` plus `age` passes validation, and a report with `age: 0` plus `timestamp` passes. The check must be presence-based (`"age" in self.initial_data` / `is not None`), otherwise the Working Draft vs Editor's Draft exclusivity is not enforced and invalid mixed reports are accepted.

findings.title: Merged-PR template calls _truncate_title on wrong class
findings.body: CommitContextIntegration.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template does `PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(title)` but `_truncate_title` is defined as a staticmethod on CommitContextIntegration, not on PRCommentWorkflow. At runtime this raises AttributeError when rendering a merged-PR suspect-issue comment, breaking GitHub/GitLab PR commenting. It should call `self._truncate_title` or `CommitContextIntegration._truncate_title`.

findings.title: Detector update reads wrong validated_data key for type
findings.body: update() does `validated_data.get("detector_type", instance.group_type).slug` while create() uses `validated_data["type"].slug` and the serializer field is named `type`. Because `detector_type` is never present, update always falls back to the existing group_type, so changing a detector's type via PUT silently does nothing.

findings.title: Error details misaligned by zipping ids with dict values
findings.body: fetch_error_details does `zip(error_ids, events.values())` where `events` is the dict returned by `nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids)`. Dict value order is not guaranteed to match `error_ids` order, and missing nodes shrink the values list, so titles/messages/timestamps can be attributed to the wrong error id or dropped. The code must look up each node id individually instead of zipping.

findings.title: Table widget flag renders empty table instead of real results
findings.body: When `organization.features.includes('use-table-widget-visualization')` the branch renders `<TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}}} />`, discarding `result.data`, `result.meta`, `fields`, loading state and custom renderers. Enabling the flag blanks every dashboard table widget.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature gate and validation
findings.body: analytics.record("preprod_artifact.api.assemble") runs before the `organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble` feature check and before body validation. Disabled-feature, unauthorized, and malformed requests are all counted as assemble attempts, polluting metrics. The record call should happen after the feature gate (and ideally after validation).
